title: Notion – The AI workspace
description: Notion is arguably the most influential SaaS landing page of the past decade. The page uses a revolutionary serif/sans-serif hybrid typography approach — Playfair Display or similar serif for elegant headings paired with Inter for clean body text. The hero features a full-width product mockup on a subtle gradient background showing Notions actual interface. The design philosophy is radical restraint: generous whitespace, no aggressive CTAs, no overwhelming feature lists. Below the fold, feature sections use staggered card layouts with icons and brief descriptions. A dedicated templates section showcases community-created templates. Testimonial cards appear with customer logos and quotes. The page uses subtle scroll animations with elements fading upward. The color palette is almost entirely grayscale with a distinctive yellow accent (#FFD02B) carefully placed on CTAs and highlights. What makes Notions page remarkable is how it feels more like a high-end editorial site than a SaaS marketing page. The design communicates confidence through simplicity — it trusts the product and brand to speak for themselves. The page has inspired countless copycat designs and established serif typography as a legitimate choice for tech products.
primary_use_case: Live design inspiration for notion-style products.
